title: Extended Auto Warranty Scam Statistics (2026)
summary: A consumer-affairs statistics page on auto warranty robocall scams notes legitimate providers rarely cold-call, and that most buyers never use their coverage.

assertions.quote: Legitimate warranty companies almost never make cold calls, so unexpected phone calls usually signal that the offer is a scam
Only 1 in 10, however, actually use their warranty

verdicts.note: Consumer Reports' survey found 55% of buyers never used their extended warranty for repairs.

assertions.quote: An affordable extended warranty may be a wise purchase if you're likely to have trouble paying repair bills
